summary: Colony Bankcorp filed an 8-K reporting that its bank subsidiary entered a new employment agreement with R. Dallis Copeland, Jr., effective September 13, 2026, continuing him as President of both the holding company and Colony Bank after his prior agreement expired. Terms include a two-year term, $400,000 annual base salary, discretionary annual bonus, 27 days PTO, one-times salary severance outside a change-in-control context, and two-times salary plus prior bonus if terminated within twelve months after a change in control. No board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated; this is an ordinary compensatory arrangement, not a special situation.
